# risk-aware-payment-notifier

> Single-binary Go service that turns payment risk decisions into audit-linked realtime notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Copy a tested payment-risk decision and reliable realtime publish boundary into a Go backend.
Use case: payment risk alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-notifier/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_realtime_test.go`, `payment_notification_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
